stem.text: Three resistors are connected in parallel across a power supply, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit of three resistors connected in parallel across a supply marked plus and minus, with resistors labelled 2 ohm, 3 ohm and 4 ohm.

stem.text: The power dissipated in each of the resistors of resistance $2\,\Omega$, $3\,\Omega$ and $4\,\Omega$ is $P_{2}$, $P_{3}$ and $P_{4}$ respectively.
What is the ratio $P_{2} : P_{3} : P_{4}$?
